etwork convergence Automatic expiry: Tokens automatically expire and cannot be reused The validation token issued by Turnstile is valid for five minutes. If a user submits the form after this period, the token is considered expired. In this scenario, the server-side verification API will return a failure, and the error-codes field in the response will include timeout-or-duplicate . To ensure a successful validation, the visitor must initiate the request and submit the token to your backend within the five-minute window. Otherwise, the Turnstile w
